abort.export_started: Discovery dump export started. The YAML file is written in the background — a notification will appear when it is ready.
abort.changes_saved: Settings saved and applied — the integration is reloading.
abort.entities_purged: Cleanup finished: stale entities were removed and entities without data were switched off.
abort.purge_not_confirmed: Nothing was removed or switched off.
abort.purge_unavailable: Purge was refused because active discovery data is unavailable.
abort.rediscover_started: eBUS rediscovery started. Entities will reappear as discovery completes.
abort.rediscover_unavailable: Rediscovery was refused because the integration is not loaded.
abort.nothing_to_purge: There are no stale entities to remove and no entities to switch off.

confirm.title: ebusd is unreachable
confirm.description: The integration cannot reach the ebusd daemon. Start ebusd and check the connection settings, then select Submit to dismiss this repair. The integration checks ebusd again and shows the repair again if it is still unreachable.

confirm.title: Remove stale entities

abort.cleanup_unavailable: The integration is not connected to ebusd right now, so nothing was removed. Try again when ebusd is reachable.
